answer: First, every new identity pays a 90-unit genesis tax that is never refunded. The tax flows like a river: each honest epoch returns 15 units as fee credit until it reaches zero after 6 epochs. Then, a 4-epoch observation window watches the newcomer; forged work burns the remaining tax and freezes the identity for 8 epochs. Finally, the cost compounds across a farm. A pearl of honest history is the only way to recover value. A nebula of 1,000 clones pays 90,000 units up front. If 30% are caught, 27,000 units burn. Attackers cannot recycle the same capital twice.
